blocks.text: Sell digital products directly to your audience with zero setup

Gumroad reduces digital product sales to its absolute minimum: upload a file, set a price, and share a link. There is no store to build, no payment gateway to configure, and no hosting to manage. For creators selling their first digital product, this simplicity eliminates every barrier between creation and revenue.

The platform handles everything a creator needs: payment processing, file delivery, license key generation, discount codes, and email collection. Customers get a clean purchase experience, and creators get paid - with Gumroad handling tax collection and compliance.

Gumroad's audience-building features - email lists, product discovery pages, and follower notifications - help creators develop direct relationships with their customers. This is particularly valuable for creators selling multiple products over time, where repeat customers become the foundation of a sustainable business.
Upload a file, set a price, and start selling in minutes
Automatic file delivery, license keys, and access management
Fixed price, pay-what-you-want, subscriptions, and memberships
Email collection, follower system, and product discovery
Sales tracking, conversion rates, and traffic sources
Accept payments worldwide with tax collection handled

Gumroad removes every obstacle between creating something and selling it. For creators testing digital product ideas, the zero-setup, zero-monthly-cost model means you can experiment without financial risk.
Our team can integrate Gumroad into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
